A rough-looking short sword capable of simple telescoping adjustments.
After Crane Qing and Crow Hui returned to the mountains and later left again, they were placed under Zhang Wanshi's tutelage.
As a child, Qing was playful and once submitted this sword as a hastily made training assignment. Crow, seeing its shoddy quality, feared their senior brother's anger. With the deadline looming, he hastily added a concealed needle mechanism inside.
Later, Senior Brother Zhang Wanshi reviewed the sword, remarking that for Qing and Crow's age, crafting something whimsical was fitting. Embarrassed and indignant, the two thereafter never again produced what their senior brother called "childish" works.
Zhang Wanshi quietly kept this "one-of-a-kind" piece as a treasure.
